summary: Building destruction/debris quantities assessment. Coordinates environmental safeguards with public works, disposal sites, or recovery actors.

New 2024 mechanism convening UN support on debris management.

Ten UN entities: UN-Habitat, UNEP, UNDP, ILO, OCHA, UNMAS, UNESCO, IOM, FAO and UNOPS.
Channel for environmental safeguards in rubble handling.
Adds a practical accountability layer outside the implementing agencies.
